horoscope: You are living with a little more intensity today, dear Aries, and you're especially generous with your feelings toward those you care about, but also quite aware of anyone who may be taking advantage. Try to avoid playing games with your affection or care - a very small tendency today. Even so, this is a powerful time to learn exactly where you should be putting your energy. Throwing yourself into an enjoyable pursuit can be rewarding now, but overdoing things is a potential pitfall. With the Moon in your solar eighth house all day, it's a good time for finding answers to recent emotional dilemmas, largely because the pipeline to your inner world and deeper needs or desires is open today.

There can be a stronger attachment to a partner or special friend today, dear Taurus. Watch for the tendency to people-please, however. If you go too far in supporting others, you could end up feeling resentful or lost. You should also watch for putting too much attention, time, or energy into a relationship at the expense of other life departments. Otherwise, with the right balance, it's a good time to bond and show how much you care. It's also a fine time to consult with others, whether formal or informal, as you tend to come alive through one-on-one interaction and learn a lot about yourself through the mirror of relationships.

There can be a stronger focus on diet and health today, dear Gemini, or a special interest in taking good care of yourself and of others through support, advice, and practical help. Watch for overdoing this, or for taking on far too much work today, particularly work for others that is at the expense of your own. Avoid setting yourself up for resentment down the road. The Moon spends the day in your sector of routines and daily affairs, and you are more invested than usual in these things. Your desire to perform, serve, and otherwise make yourself useful is kindled.

The desire to create is powerful in you today, dear Cancer, with the Moon in your solar fifth house all day. It's a time for really throwing yourself into developing, attending to, or building a relationship, business, project, or hobby, however big or small. This can be deeply satisfying, but if you take it too far, other areas of life could suffer a little! Today's Moon encourages a focus on the more playful, expressive, and pleasurable elements of your life. Now is a good time to think of ways to improve the more spontaneous, entertaining side of your life.

This can be a strong day for self-renewal through familiar activities, retreat, nesting, or cocooning, dear Leo. You are more likely to show your affection for the people and things that you can most count on. Overdoing it, however, through overprotecting, for example, may not go over very well. Aim for moderation today. The Moon spends the day at the bottom of your solar chart, and the need or desire to decompress and enjoy familiar settings is strong. The Moon pulls you into yourself, and Jupiter encourages you to go your own way and keep your options open. Whether to play it safe or take a chance may be a question. However, tapping excess energy and channeling it into a useful project or special activity can be rewarding.

Your practical intelligence is always a strength for you, dear Virgo, but today, it's in special focus or showcased in some natural way, and others are appreciating you for it. There may be opportunities to teach, help, support, advise, or mentor. You are also good at mediating, as your desire to restore or nurture peace in your personal environment is strong. Communications that show you care can be especially well-received today. The Moon spends the day in your communications sector, encouraging you to put your feelers out for new information. You're inclined to get involved in many small jobs or odds and ends rather than focusing too much on any one thing.

You can be putting more effort into taking care of or acquiring personal possessions, money, or resources today, dear Libra. You are generous with others, and possibly a little indulgent right now. Watch that you don't use money or your own generosity to excess, as it's a small tendency today. The Moon spends the day in your solar second house, and this draws your attention to how you're managing your resources. Your material affairs and comforts can be in focus, but you might also pay particular attention to your desire for security and predictability. If you can get on top of a tendency to take on more than you can handle now, you'll better and more fully enjoy what's in front of you.

While there is an increased focus on your personal needs and wants today, dear Scorpio, there is also a gentle way about you, and others are seeing your warmth, care, and concern. People may be coming to you for guidance and support. There is a tendency to want to pamper and indulge yourself. Personal magnetism is good today. With the Moon in your sign all day, you are in a strong position for acknowledging unmet needs and feelings that you've recently kept at bay. You crave a feeling of connectedness, and others notice you more than usual. The potential pitfall of today is going over the top with all of this, and if you do, when you come back down to earth, you may wonder why you pushed yourself so far.

You have a stronger capacity for forgiveness, compassion, and reconciliation today, dear Sagittarius. You may need to make some minor self-sacrifice to support or care for others. You are a little more retiring or withdrawn today, and you may be doing work or tasks behind the scenes. Any latent longings for spiritual connections can be stirring now with mixed results. Those things that help you heal, or lead you to greater self-understanding, are in focus today. With the Moon in your solar twelfth house all day, you need a break from hectic or demanding situations. The potential problem of the day involves overdoing things, and in your case, this may be a too-intense inventory of the past.

This can be a fruitful and creative day for teamwork, friendships, and networking, dear Capricorn, although if overdone, productivity in other areas can suffer. You can feel strong vitality and energy in the connections you're making now. A humanitarian streak is stirring today. Others sense that you're more invested in their well-being and are quicker to return the favor. This is a great time for learning about yourself and your direction from and with others. The Moon spends another day in your social sector, and this is a good time in the lunar month to seek out friends and inspiration. With the Moon's square to Jupiter, however, it's important not to take on too much, as tempted as you may be with new ventures and ideas.

Some of your best, most natural qualities are brought out and appreciated today, dear Aquarius. You have much to share and learn through the connections you make. You may be modeling an open-minded perspective, taking the lead indirectly in this way, as you could find this is the most effective solution to dealing with any narrow-mindedness around you. You are inclined to resolve problems, particularly regarding educational, travel, moral, and philosophical matters. Good energy is with you to take charge, and you can handle practical matters quite creatively. The energies of the day stir your ambitions, and you can find yourself thinking in especially big terms. Watch for the tendency to want to bite off more than you can chew, but do stretch your mind to consider possibilities and opportunities where you may not have seen them in the past.

There is a breezy way about you today, dear Pisces, but as you offer others freedom, you are also expressing your confidence in the people in your life. You're seeking learning experiences right now, and you're likely to find them. You can also be taking in important, helpful, and even healing information. There is a strong tendency to focus so much on plans for the future that you forget to enjoy the moment in small ways today. However, stretching your mind and entertaining strong possibilities is entirely encouraged now. The key now is to keep this moderate and not let goals and promises of the future make the present look dull or depressing.
